description: A complete nightly run with 10/10 Job-log PASS and surviving metrics produces a LIVENESS GO Notion page and notifies the user.
assertions: resolve-run.py returns the token djynkpbrn0q0 and orders tokens by base36 value
query-grafana.py forces max_source_resolution=0 and is time-scoped (no instant-now)

collect-run-log.py joins the token to a nightly Job by window-containment (Job run window contains the decoded UnixNano) AND log-verification (the Job's log references this run's chaos-<token>- chains); no verified match yields VERDICT UNAVAILABLE
collect-run-log.py extracts SEID_IMAGE_CHAOS and per-scenario --- PASS|FAIL
compute-stats.py summary headline == 'LIVENESS GO' (never a bare 'GO')
push-notion.py payload carries the run-identity header (token, image, run age) and the tx-correctness caveat inline
notion-create-pages is called once
AC4: a git grep for the removed recording-rule prefix and the removed S3 report filename returns nothing under the skill

description: AC3 — log GC'd (7d) but metrics survive (15d): every scenario renders VERDICT UNAVAILABLE and the headline is suppressed, never a synthesized pass. Token djq5b97fgi68 decodes to ~11 days before the run date (log GC'd past 7d, metrics still within the 15d raw bound).
assertions: collect-run-log.py writes log_available=false with a GC'd reason and exits 0 (does not crash)
compute-stats.py marks each scenario 'VERDICT UNAVAILABLE — metrics-only' with provenance VERDICT-GC'd
compute-stats.py summary headline is null and headline_suppressed is true
push-notion.py renders NO go/no-go headline
no scenario is rendered as a synthesized PASS

description: AC6 — a run older than the ~15d raw bound discovers no chains and yields a graceful 'raw expired' result, not a crash or empty page.
assertions: resolve-run.py --run <ancient-token> exits 1 with a 'raw expired / wrong token' message
the skill surfaces raw-expired to the user and offers a re-run
no crash, no empty Notion page

description: AC7 — a genuinely halted chain is flagged HALTED even in pod-failure/container-kill, and a healthy chain with one restarted validator (new pod/instance series) reads ADVANCING (not fooled by a gauge reset).

mocks.healthy_with_restart: 3 validators advance + 1 restarts as a new instance series
mocks.genuine_halt: set advances early then flat for > final-N samples

assertions: healthy-with-restart -> verdict ADVANCING (set-level advancement, not per-fixed-series delta)
genuine-halt -> verdict HALTED (final-N-samples guard catches advance-early-then-stop)
absent series -> verdict 'NO DATA' (never a green 0)

description: AC5 — a scenario with no Job-log line reconciles to DID NOT RUN (complete log) and a scenario with no metric series shows NO DATA; a truncated log marks unmatched scenarios UNKNOWN.
assertions: a complete log missing 'time-skew' -> outcome 'DID NOT RUN'
a truncated log missing 'time-skew' -> outcome 'UNKNOWN (log truncated)'
a scenario with an empty metric series -> provenance 'NO DATA', never a measured 0

description: Skill refuses to proceed when GRAFANA_TOKEN is not set.
assertions: check-grafana.sh exits 1 and prints the service-account setup instructions
resolve-run.py / query-grafana.py are not run
notion-create-pages is not called
no state directory is created
